scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client')) process.chdir('client'); require('child_process').execSync('npm install && npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client')) process.chdir('client'); require('child_process').execSync('npm run start', {stdio:'inherit'})"
